becomes the loudest accuser after staying quiet for two rounds is over-correcting.

make, in round 4 you've said one thing. What changed?' Use Appeal to Logic
framing.

becomes the loudest accuser after staying quiet for two rounds is over-correcting.

make, in round 4 you've said one thing. What changed?' Use Appeal to Logic
framing.
